items.englishDefinition: to provide a reason for a situation or result
items.cue: 財務與投資情境：account for a difference
items.notes: 不可分：account for it。此處學解釋原因，與占某百分比的詞義分開。

examples.english: Can you account for the difference between these two totals?
examples.chinese: 你能解釋這兩個總額之間的差異嗎？

examples.english: The accountant could not account for the missing receipts.
examples.chinese: 會計無法說明收據遺失的原因。

items.cue: Seeking a job or opportunity

examples.english: You can apply for this job through our website.
examples.chinese: 你可以透過我們的網站申請這份工作。

items.englishDefinition: to save an extra copy of files so they can be recovered
items.cue: 設施與環境情境：back up files
items.notes: 可分：back the files up；代名詞用 back them up。back up 是動詞，backup 是名詞或形容詞。

examples.english: Please back up the customer database before installing the update.
examples.chinese: 安裝更新前，請先備份客戶資料庫。

examples.english: These files are important, so back them up to another drive.
examples.chinese: 這些檔案很重要，請把它們備份到另一個磁碟。

items.cue: A payment deadline
collocations: be due at the end of the month

examples.english: The first payment is due on the fifteenth of May.
examples.chinese: 第一筆款項應在五月十五日支付。

items.cue: Knowing a tool or procedure

examples.english: Applicants should be familiar with basic accounting software.
examples.chinese: 應徵者應熟悉基本的會計軟體。

items.cue: Leading an activity
collocations: be in charge of a team

examples.english: Mia is in charge of the new employee training program.
examples.chinese: Mia 負責管理新進員工訓練計畫。

items.cue: What a price covers

examples.english: Breakfast is included in the room rate.
examples.chinese: 房價已包含早餐。

items.cue: Duties in a job description

examples.english: The assistant is responsible for scheduling interviews.
examples.chinese: 這位助理負責安排面試。

items.cue: A machine stops working

examples.english: If the copier breaks down, contact the maintenance team.
examples.chinese: 如果影印機故障，請聯絡維修團隊。

items.cue: Covering costs without a profit

examples.english: The cafe needs to sell eighty meals a day to break even.
examples.chinese: 這間咖啡館每天需要賣出八十份餐點，才能收支打平。

items.englishDefinition: to move a scheduled event to an earlier time
items.cue: 會議與溝通情境：bring forward a meeting
items.notes: 可分：bring the meeting forward。提前與 put off（延後）相反；日期用 to 加新的時間。

examples.english: We have brought forward the interview from Friday to Wednesday.
examples.chinese: 我們已把面試從星期五提前到星期三。

examples.english: The launch was scheduled for June, but the team wants to bring it forward.
examples.chinese: 原定六月推出，但團隊想提前。

items.meaning: 請來；引入（人員協助工作）
items.englishDefinition: to involve an additional person in a task
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：bring in a consultant
items.notes: 可分：bring the consultant in；代名詞用 bring her in。此處學引入人員，不是賺得收入。

examples.english: We will bring in an outside consultant to review the new process.
examples.chinese: 我們將請外部顧問審查新流程。

examples.english: The repairs are complex, so we should bring in a specialist.
examples.chinese: 維修工作很複雜，因此我們應該請專家協助。

items.meaning: 提出（供討論的話題或問題）
items.englishDefinition: to mention a subject for discussion
items.cue: 會議與溝通情境：bring up an issue
items.notes: 可分：bring the issue up；代名詞用 bring it up。bring 的過去式為 brought。

examples.english: Please bring up the parking problem at tomorrow's staff meeting.
examples.chinese: 請在明天的員工會議提出停車問題。

examples.english: I noticed an error in the proposal and brought it up with the manager.
examples.chinese: 我注意到提案有錯誤，便向經理提出。

items.meaning: 取消（原定的活動或安排）
items.englishDefinition: to cancel an event that was planned
items.cue: 會議與溝通情境：call off a meeting
items.notes: 可分：call the meeting off；代名詞用 call it off。取消與 put off（延期）不同。

examples.english: The organizer called off the outdoor reception because of heavy rain.
examples.chinese: 主辦單位因大雨取消了戶外招待會。

examples.english: If too few people register, we may have to call it off.
examples.chinese: 如果報名人數太少，我們可能必須取消活動。

items.englishDefinition: to continue an activity without stopping
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：carry on working
items.notes: carry on 加動名詞；carry on with 加工作或事情。不要用 carry on to work 表示繼續工作。

examples.english: We can carry on with the meeting while the technician fixes the microphone.
examples.chinese: 技術人員修理麥克風時，我們可以繼續開會。

examples.english: The team carried on working until the urgent order was ready.
examples.chinese: 團隊繼續工作，直到急件準備好。

items.englishDefinition: to do a planned task or activity
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：carry out an inspection
items.notes: 可分：carry the inspection out；代名詞放中間：carry it out。

examples.english: The maintenance team will carry out a safety inspection on Thursday.
examples.chinese: 維修團隊將於星期四進行安全檢查。

examples.english: We agreed on the plan and will carry it out next month.
examples.chinese: 我們已就計畫達成共識，並將於下個月執行。

items.meaning: 補做；補上之前落下的事
items.englishDefinition: to do work or obtain information that was missed earlier
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：catch up on email
items.notes: 不可分：catch up on it。on 後接落下的工作；catch up with 常接人或進度。

examples.english: I need an hour to catch up on email after my business trip.
examples.chinese: 出差回來後，我需要一個小時補處理電子郵件。

examples.english: The assistant stayed late to catch up on the week's paperwork.
examples.chinese: 助理留下來加班，補做本週落下的文書工作。

items.cue: at the start of an air journey

examples.english: You should check in for your flight at least two hours before departure.
examples.chinese: 你應至少在起飛前兩小時辦理登機報到。

items.cue: At the end of a hotel stay

examples.english: We need to check out of the hotel before eleven.
examples.chinese: 我們需要在十一點以前辦理退房。

additionalSenses.meaning: 查看；檢查（以了解或確認）
additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to examine something to learn about it or verify it
additionalSenses.cue: 行銷與客服情境：check out a product
additionalSenses.notes: 可分：check the details out；代名詞用 check them out。與既有 check out 的退房詞義分開。

examples.english: You can check out the new display at our downtown store.
examples.chinese: 你可以到我們市中心的商店看看新的展示。

examples.english: These product claims seem unusual, so we should check them out.
examples.chinese: 這些產品宣稱有些異常，因此我們應該查證。

items.englishDefinition: to produce an idea or possible solution
items.cue: 會議與溝通情境：come up with an idea
items.notes: 不可分：come up with it。come 的過去式為 came。

examples.english: Can the team come up with a better way to reduce waiting times?
examples.chinese: 團隊能想出更好的方法來縮短等候時間嗎？

examples.english: Nina came up with a simple solution during the planning meeting.
examples.chinese: Nina 在規劃會議中提出了簡單的解決方案。

items.englishDefinition: to act according to a rule or requirement
items.cue: 商務與法規情境：comply with regulations
items.notes: 介系詞動詞；with 後接規範或要求，不可分：comply with them。

examples.english: All suppliers must comply with our safety requirements.
examples.chinese: 所有供應商都必須遵守我們的安全要求。

examples.english: The new packaging complies with local recycling regulations.
examples.chinese: 新包裝符合當地的回收規定。

items.englishDefinition: to have something as a main and necessary part or quality
items.notes:
consist in：在於。
consist of：由……組成。

examples.english: The beauty of air travel consists in its speed and ease.
examples.chinese: 乘飛機旅行的好處在於快捷、舒適。

examples.english: For her, happiness consists in watching television and reading magazines.
examples.chinese: 對她來說，幸福就是看電視和讀雜誌。

items.englishDefinition: to reduce spending or the amount of an activity
items.cue: 財務與投資情境：cut back on expenses
items.notes: 不可分：cut back on it。常用於預算調整，與 cut down on 的減少概念相近。

examples.english: The department will cut back on travel expenses next quarter.
examples.chinese: 部門下季將削減差旅支出。

examples.english: We are using online meetings to cut back on business travel.
examples.chinese: 我們正使用線上會議來減少商務旅行。

items.englishDefinition: to use or do less of something
items.cue: 設施與環境情境：cut down on waste
items.notes: 不可分：cut down on it。cut 的過去式仍為 cut；on 後接要減少的事。

examples.english: Digital receipts help the store cut down on paper use.
examples.chinese: 電子收據能幫助商店減少紙張用量。

examples.english: We can cut down on waste by ordering only what we need.
examples.chinese: 只訂購需要的物品，就能減少浪費。

items.cue: Handling a problem or request

examples.english: The service desk deals with customer requests every day.
examples.chinese: 服務櫃檯每天都會處理顧客的請求。

items.englishDefinition: to be determined by a particular factor
items.cue: 商務與法規情境：depend on demand
items.notes: 介系詞動詞，不可分：depend on it。此處學取決於，與依賴他人的詞義區別。

examples.english: The final delivery date will depend on stock availability.
examples.chinese: 最終配送日期將取決於庫存情況。

examples.english: Whether we hire more staff depends on next quarter's sales.
examples.chinese: 我們是否增聘員工，取決於下季的銷售額。

items.englishDefinition: to prepare a written agreement or detailed plan
items.cue: 商務與法規情境：draw up a contract
items.notes: 可分：draw the contract up；代名詞用 draw it up。draw 的過去式為 drew，過去分詞為 drawn。

examples.english: Our legal adviser will draw up a new service agreement.
examples.chinese: 我們的法律顧問將草擬新的服務合約。

examples.english: The team discussed the schedule and drew it up before the launch.
examples.chinese: 團隊討論了時程，並在推出前擬定完成。

items.englishDefinition: to visit a place informally for a short time
items.cue: 會議與溝通情境：drop by the office
items.notes: 常直接接地點：drop by our office；也可單獨使用，語氣較隨意。

examples.english: Feel free to drop by our booth if you have questions about the product.
examples.chinese: 如果對產品有疑問，歡迎順道到我們的攤位。

examples.english: The sales representative dropped by the office to deliver a new catalog.
examples.chinese: 業務代表順道到辦公室送來新型錄。

items.meaning: 順道送交；送到指定地點
items.cue: Leaving something for collection

examples.english: Please drop off the documents at reception before noon.
examples.chinese: 請在中午以前將文件送到接待處。

items.englishDefinition: To take part in an activity.

examples.english: Each worker has engaged in at least two projects
examples.chinese: 每位員工都已參與至少兩個專案。

items.englishDefinition: to understand something by thinking about it
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：figure out a problem
items.notes: 可分：figure it out；也常接 how、why、what 等疑問詞子句。

examples.english: Can you figure out why the printer keeps stopping?
examples.chinese: 你能弄清楚印表機為何一直停止運作嗎？

examples.english: The instructions are unclear, but our technician can figure them out.
examples.chinese: 說明不清楚，但我們的技術人員能弄懂。

items.cue: While a colleague is away

examples.english: Could you fill in for me while I am on leave?
examples.chinese: 我休假時，你可以替我代班嗎？

additionalSenses.meaning: 填寫空白欄位；填妥表格
additionalSenses.englishDefinition: to add the required information to blank spaces in a document
additionalSenses.cue: 職場與人事情境：fill in a form
additionalSenses.notes: 可分：fill the form in；代名詞用 fill it in。與既有 fill in 的代班詞義分開。

examples.english: Please fill in your contact details before submitting the application.
examples.chinese: 提交申請前，請填妥你的聯絡資料。

examples.english: The form has several blank fields; fill them in before the interview.
examples.chinese: 表格有幾個空白欄位，請在面試前填妥。

items.cue: Providing information on a form

examples.english: Please fill out the visitor form at reception.
examples.chinese: 請在接待處填寫訪客表格。

items.englishDefinition: to learn information that was not previously known
items.cue: 會議與溝通情境：find out the reason
collocations: find out whether a room is available
items.notes: 常接 what、why、whether 等疑問詞子句；find out about 後接想了解的事。

examples.english: Please find out whether the conference room is available on Monday.
examples.chinese: 請查明會議室星期一是否可用。

examples.english: We found out that the supplier had changed its delivery schedule.
examples.chinese: 我們得知供應商已更改配送時程。

items.cue: After an earlier conversation

examples.english: I will follow up with the client after the meeting.
examples.chinese: 會議結束後，我會再和客戶聯繫。

items.englishDefinition: If two or more people get along, they like each other and are friendly to each other.

examples.english: I don't really get along with my sister's husband.
examples.chinese: 我跟姊夫／妹夫相處得不太好。

additionalSenses.englishDefinition: To make progress or manage in a particular situation.

examples.english: I wonder how Michael is getting along in his new job?
examples.chinese: 我想知道麥可在新工作中進展如何。

items.englishDefinition: to respond to someone after obtaining information or having time
items.cue: 會議與溝通情境：get back to a customer
collocations: get back to someone with an answer
items.notes: 不可分：get back to you。後面接回覆對象，可用 with 加回覆內容。

examples.english: I will get back to you after I confirm the delivery date.
examples.chinese: 確認配送日期後，我會再回覆你。

examples.english: The account manager got back to the client with a revised quotation.
examples.chinese: 客戶經理以修訂後的報價回覆客戶。

items.cue: Starting communication
collocations: get in touch with a client

examples.english: I will get in touch with the supplier this afternoon.
examples.chinese: 我今天下午會和供應商聯繫。

items.cue: Leaving public transport
collocations: get off at the next stop

examples.english: Get off at the next stop and walk two blocks to the office.
examples.chinese: 在下一站下車，再走兩個街區就到辦公室。

items.meaning: 登上公車、火車等交通工具
items.cue: Boarding public transport

examples.english: Please let passengers get off before you get on the train.
examples.chinese: 上火車前，請先讓乘客下車。

items.englishDefinition: to provide something to a group of people
items.cue: 行銷與客服情境：give out samples
items.notes: 可分：give them out。此處學分發，不是燃料耗盡或設備失靈的詞義。

examples.english: The sales team will give out free samples at the exhibition.
examples.chinese: 業務團隊將在展覽會發放免費樣品。

examples.english: We have fifty discount coupons and plan to give them out this afternoon.
examples.chinese: 我們有五十張折價券，計畫今天下午發放。

items.englishDefinition: to review something carefully
items.cue: 會議與溝通情境：go over a report
items.notes: 不可分：go over it。常用於會議前核對資料或逐項確認細節。

examples.english: Let's go over the presentation once more before the client arrives.
examples.chinese: 客戶抵達前，我們再仔細檢查一次簡報吧。

examples.english: I have read the contract, but I want to go over it with our adviser.
examples.chinese: 我已看過合約，但想和顧問再核對一次。

items.englishDefinition: to examine the contents of something in detail
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：go through applications
items.notes: 不可分：go through them。此處學逐一檢查，與經歷困難等其他詞義分開。

examples.english: The hiring team will go through all applications this week.
examples.chinese: 招聘團隊本週將逐一查看所有申請。

examples.english: These records are incomplete, so please go through them with the accountant.
examples.chinese: 這些紀錄不完整，請和會計逐一檢查。

items.englishDefinition: to give a document to the person responsible for collecting it
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：hand in a report
items.notes: 可分：hand the report in；代名詞用 hand it in。常接 by 加截止時間。

examples.english: Please hand in your travel expense form by Tuesday.
examples.chinese: 請在星期二以前繳交差旅費表格。

examples.english: Your supervisor needs the report today, so hand it in before lunch.
examples.chinese: 主管今天需要這份報告，請在午餐前繳交。

items.englishDefinition: to give items to several people
items.cue: 會議與溝通情境：hand out materials
items.notes: 可分：hand the materials out；代名詞用 hand them out。

examples.english: The trainer will hand out the exercise sheets after the introduction.
examples.chinese: 講師將在介紹結束後分發練習單。

examples.english: The name tags are ready; please hand them out at the entrance.
examples.chinese: 名牌已準備好，請在入口處分發。

items.cue: Offering food or drinks

examples.english: Please help yourself to coffee while you wait.
examples.chinese: 等候時，請自行取用咖啡。

items.englishDefinition: to prevent someone or something from proceeding on time
items.cue: 產品與物流情境：hold up a delivery
items.notes: 可分：hold the delivery up；代名詞用 hold it up。hold 的過去式為 held。

examples.english: A customs inspection held up the shipment for two days.
examples.chinese: 海關檢查使貨件延誤了兩天。

examples.english: One missing signature could hold up the entire approval process.
examples.chinese: 少了一個簽名可能耽擱整個核准流程。

items.englishDefinition: to stay at the same pace as work or changing information
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：keep up with demand
items.notes: 不可分：keep up with them。與 catch up on（補做落下的工作）區別。

examples.english: The warehouse hired more staff to keep up with rising demand.
examples.chinese: 倉庫增聘人手，以跟上不斷增加的需求。

examples.english: Regular training helps employees keep up with changes in the software.
examples.chinese: 定期訓練能幫助員工跟上軟體的變化。

items.englishDefinition: to end workers' employment because the business has less work
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：lay off workers
items.notes: 可分：lay the workers off；代名詞用 lay them off。過去式 laid off，與員工自行 resign 不同。

examples.english: The factory had to lay off some workers after losing a major contract.
examples.chinese: 工廠失去一份重要合約後，不得不裁減部分員工。

examples.english: The company hopes to avoid laying off staff by reducing other expenses.
examples.chinese: 公司希望透過減少其他支出來避免裁員。

items.englishDefinition: to enter a computer system using account details
items.cue: 設施與環境情境：log in to a system
items.notes: 常用 log in to 加系統名稱，或 log in with 加登入方式。log in 是動詞，login 常作名詞或形容詞。

examples.english: Please log in to the staff portal to view your schedule.
examples.chinese: 請登入員工入口網站查看你的班表。

examples.english: You can log in with your employee number and temporary password.
examples.chinese: 你可以用員工編號和臨時密碼登入。

items.englishDefinition: to end an account session on a computer system
items.cue: 設施與環境情境：log out of a system
items.notes: 常用 log out of 加系統名稱；與 log in 相反。

examples.english: Remember to log out of the shared computer after checking your email.
examples.chinese: 查看郵件後，記得登出共用電腦。

examples.english: The system will log you out automatically after twenty minutes of inactivity.
examples.chinese: 系統會在你閒置二十分鐘後自動將你登出。

items.englishDefinition: to take care of a person or thing
items.cue: 旅遊與生活情境：look after guests
items.notes: 不可分：look after them。與 look for（尋找）及 look into（調查）區別。

examples.english: The tour guide will look after the guests during the excursion.
examples.chinese: 導遊將在短途旅行期間照料旅客。

examples.english: Could you look after my bag while I speak to the receptionist?
examples.chinese: 我和接待人員說話時，你能幫我看管行李嗎？

items.cue: A polite message ending

examples.english: We look forward to meeting you at the conference.
examples.chinese: 我們期待在研討會上與你見面。

items.englishDefinition: to examine an issue to learn more about it
items.cue: 行銷與客服情境：look into a complaint
items.notes: 不可分：look into it，不用 look it into。常用於客服回覆與問題調查。

examples.english: Our support team will look into the missing shipment today.
examples.chinese: 我們的客服團隊今天將調查遺失的貨件。

examples.english: Thank you for reporting the error; we are looking into it.
examples.chinese: 謝謝你回報錯誤，我們正在調查。

items.englishDefinition: to search a reference source for information
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：look up a number
items.notes: 可分：look the number up；代名詞用 look it up。與 look for（尋找人或物）不同。

examples.english: You can look up the product code in the online catalog.
examples.chinese: 你可以在網路型錄查找產品代碼。

examples.english: I do not know the extension number, but I can look it up.
examples.chinese: 我不知道分機號碼，但可以查一下。

items.cue: Arranging a table or room

examples.english: I would like to make a reservation for four people at seven.
examples.chinese: 我想預訂七點的四人座位。

items.englishDefinition: to provide something that compensates for a loss or problem
items.cue: 行銷與客服情境：make up for a delay
items.notes: 不可分：make up for it。與 make up（編造、和好等）分開學。

examples.english: The hotel offered a free breakfast to make up for the check-in delay.
examples.chinese: 飯店提供免費早餐，以彌補入住報到的延誤。

examples.english: The team worked faster to make up for the time lost during the outage.
examples.chinese: 團隊加快工作速度，以補回停電期間損失的時間。

items.cue: Checking whether something is suitable

examples.english: The new model meets a key requirement: it can run on battery power.
examples.chinese: 新款機型符合一項關鍵要求：它能以電池供電。

items.englishDefinition: to start occupying a new home or workplace
items.cue: 設施與環境情境：move in next week
collocations: move in to a new office
items.notes: 本詞義常不接受直接受詞：move in next week。加地點可用 move into a new office。

examples.english: The renovation is complete, and the team can move in next week.
examples.chinese: 整修已完成，團隊下週可以搬入。

examples.english: New tenants may move in after signing the lease.
examples.chinese: 新租客簽完租約後即可搬入。

items.englishDefinition: to stop occupying a home or workplace and leave it
items.cue: 設施與環境情境：move out of an office
items.notes: 本詞義常不接受直接受詞；move out of 加搬出的地點。與 move in 相反。

examples.english: The company must move out of the old office before the lease expires.
examples.chinese: 公司必須在租約到期前搬出舊辦公室。

examples.english: The tenants agreed to move out by the end of the month.
examples.chinese: 租客同意在月底以前搬出。

items.cue: Before receiving a service
collocations: pay in advance for a course

examples.english: Participants must pay in advance to secure a place on the course.
examples.chinese: 參加者必須預先付款，才能保留課程名額。

items.englishDefinition: to repay all the money owed on a debt
items.cue: 財務與投資情境：pay off a loan
items.notes: 可分：pay the loan off；代名詞用 pay it off。此處學清償債務，不是努力獲得成果的詞義。

examples.english: The company plans to pay off its bank loan within three years.
examples.chinese: 公司計畫在三年內還清銀行貸款。

examples.english: The debt is small enough for us to pay it off this month.
examples.chinese: 這筆債務金額不大，我們本月就能還清。

items.meaning: 逐步淘汰；逐步停止使用
items.englishDefinition: to stop using something in planned stages
items.cue: 產品與物流情境：phase out a product
items.notes: 可分：phase the product out；代名詞用 phase it out。強調逐步，不是立即停用。

examples.english: The manufacturer will phase out the older model over the next year.
examples.chinese: 製造商將在未來一年逐步淘汰舊款機型。

examples.english: We still use paper forms, but plan to phase them out gradually.
examples.chinese: 我們仍使用紙本表格，但計畫逐步停用。

items.cue: Collecting an order

examples.english: You can pick up your order at the service counter.
examples.chinese: 你可以在服務櫃檯領取訂購的商品。

items.cue: Buying from a business
collocations: place an order with a supplier

examples.english: You can place an order online or by phone.
examples.chinese: 你可以在線上或透過電話下單。

items.englishDefinition: to direct someone's attention to a fact or detail
items.cue: 會議與溝通情境：point out an error
items.notes: 可分：point the error out；代名詞用 point it out。也可用 point out that 子句。

examples.english: The reviewer pointed out several errors in the price list.
examples.chinese: 審核人員指出價目表中的幾項錯誤。

examples.english: If you notice a missing item, please point it out before we submit the report.
examples.chinese: 如果你發現遺漏的項目，請在我們提交報告前指出。

items.englishDefinition: to produce a printed copy of a document that has been written on a computer

examples.english: Could you print out a copy of that letter for me?
examples.chinese: 你能把那封信列印一份給我嗎？

items.meaning: 提出（供考慮的建議或提案）
items.englishDefinition: to offer an idea for others to consider
items.cue: 會議與溝通情境：put forward a proposal
items.notes: 可分：put the proposal forward；代名詞用 put it forward。比 bring up 更著重提出建議。

examples.english: The committee put forward a proposal to extend the opening hours.
examples.chinese: 委員會提出了延長營業時間的提案。

examples.english: Your suggestion is useful; please put it forward at the next meeting.
examples.chinese: 你的建議很有用，請在下次會議提出。

items.englishDefinition: to move an activity to a later time
items.cue: 會議與溝通情境：put off a meeting
items.notes: 可分：put the meeting off；代名詞用 put it off。後面也可接動名詞：put off making a decision。

examples.english: We need to put off the budget meeting until Friday.
examples.chinese: 我們需要把預算會議延至星期五。

examples.english: The payment is due today, so please do not put it off.
examples.chinese: 款項今天到期，請不要延後付款。

items.englishDefinition: to assemble parts or information into a complete item
items.cue: 會議與溝通情境：put together a presentation
items.notes: 可分：put the presentation together；代名詞用 put it together。可用於資料或實體零件。

examples.english: Could you put together a short presentation about our new services?
examples.chinese: 你能整理製作一份介紹新服務的簡短簡報嗎？

examples.english: The figures are ready; now we need to put them together in one report.
examples.chinese: 數據已準備好，現在需要把它們整理成一份報告。

items.meaning: 主動聯繫；聯絡尋求或提供協助
items.englishDefinition: to contact a person or organization to begin communication
items.cue: 會議與溝通情境：reach out to a supplier
items.notes: 不可分：reach out to them。to 後接聯繫的對象。

examples.english: Please reach out to the supplier about the damaged boxes.
examples.chinese: 請主動聯繫供應商，討論箱子損壞的問題。

examples.english: Our support team will reach out to you if more information is needed.
examples.chinese: 如果需要更多資訊，我們的客服團隊會聯繫你。

items.cue: Looking at a source for information

examples.english: Refer to the manual if you need help setting up the printer.
examples.chinese: 如果你在設定印表機時需要協助，請參閱使用手冊。

items.englishDefinition: to trust someone or something to provide what is needed
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：rely on a supplier
items.notes: 介系詞動詞，不可分：rely on them。可用 rely on someone to do something。

examples.english: Small stores often rely on local suppliers for fresh produce.
examples.chinese: 小型商店常仰賴當地供應商提供新鮮農產品。

examples.english: You can rely on our team to deliver the report on time.
examples.chinese: 你可以信賴我們的團隊準時交付報告。

items.cue: Arranging local transport
collocations: rent a car for a week
rent a car at the airport

examples.english: We plan to rent a car at the airport for the business trip.
examples.chinese: 我們計畫在機場租車，供出差使用。

items.englishDefinition: to decide that a possibility should no longer be considered
items.cue: 商務與法規情境：rule out a possibility
items.notes: 可分：rule the option out；代名詞用 rule it out。常見 cannot rule out 表示尚不能排除。

examples.english: The technician ruled out a power failure as the cause of the problem.
examples.chinese: 技術人員排除了停電是問題原因的可能性。

examples.english: The proposal may be expensive, but we should not rule it out yet.
examples.chinese: 這個提案可能很昂貴，但我們還不應排除它。

items.englishDefinition: to encounter an unexpected problem
items.cue: 產品與物流情境：run into difficulties
items.notes: 不可分：run into a problem。run 的過去式為 ran；此處學遇到問題，另有偶遇他人的詞義。

examples.english: We ran into a problem while testing the new payment system.
examples.chinese: 測試新的付款系統時，我們遇到了問題。

examples.english: The project may run into difficulties if the parts arrive late.
examples.chinese: 如果零件晚到，專案可能會遇到困難。

items.cue: Having no stock left

examples.english: We have run out of packing tape and need to order more.
examples.chinese: 我們的包裝膠帶已經用完，需要再訂購。

items.englishDefinition: to sell all available items or tickets
items.cue: 行銷與客服情境：sell out quickly
items.notes: 商品或票券作主詞：the tickets sold out；商店可用 sell out of 加商品。sold 是 sell 的過去式。

examples.english: Tickets for the training conference sold out in two days.
examples.chinese: 訓練研討會的票券在兩天內售罄。

examples.english: We have sold out of the blue jackets, but the gray ones are still available.
examples.chinese: 藍色外套已售罄，但灰色款仍有貨。

items.cue: Preparing equipment for use

examples.english: We need to set up the projector before the presentation.
examples.chinese: 我們需要在簡報前架好投影機。

items.meaning: 關閉；停止運作（系統或設備）
items.englishDefinition: to stop a machine or system from operating
items.cue: 設施與環境情境：shut down a computer
items.notes: 可分：shut it down；系統自行停止可用 the system shut down。shut 的過去式仍為 shut。

examples.english: The technician will shut down the server for maintenance tonight.
examples.chinese: 技術人員今晚將關閉伺服器進行維護。

examples.english: The machine is making an unusual noise; shut it down immediately.
examples.chinese: 機器發出異常聲音，請立即關閉。

items.englishDefinition: to record that you have arrived
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：sign in at reception
items.notes: 本詞義可不接受詞：sign in at reception。此處學到場簽到；電腦登入另見 log in。

examples.english: All visitors must sign in at the reception desk.
examples.chinese: 所有訪客都必須在接待櫃檯簽到。

examples.english: Please sign in before entering the training room.
examples.chinese: 進入訓練教室前，請先簽到。

items.englishDefinition: to register to take part in an activity or service
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：sign up for a workshop
items.notes: sign up for 加活動名稱；sign up 本身可單獨使用。不要把名詞 signup 當作動詞。

examples.english: Employees can sign up for the safety workshop on the company website.
examples.chinese: 員工可以在公司網站報名參加安全講習。

examples.english: I signed up for an evening course to improve my presentation skills.
examples.chinese: 我報名了晚間課程，以提升簡報能力。

items.englishDefinition: to deal successfully with a problem or confusing situation
items.cue: 行銷與客服情境：sort out a problem
items.notes: 可分：sort the problem out；代名詞用 sort it out。

examples.english: The service desk helped us sort out the billing problem.
examples.chinese: 服務櫃檯協助我們解決帳單問題。

examples.english: There is a mistake in your order, but we will sort it out today.
examples.chinese: 你的訂單有誤，但我們今天會處理妥當。

items.englishDefinition: to leave a position of authority voluntarily
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：step down as chair
items.notes: 不接受直接受詞；step down as 加職位，step down from 加所辭的職位。

examples.english: The board chair will step down at the end of the year.
examples.chinese: 董事長將在年底卸任。

examples.english: After ten years in the role, she decided to step down as director.
examples.chinese: 擔任該職務十年後，她決定辭去主管一職。

items.englishDefinition: to make a brief visit to a place
items.cue: 旅遊與生活情境：stop by the office
items.notes: 常直接接地點：stop by the office；也可單獨用 stop by。stop by to 加拜訪目的。

examples.english: Please stop by the office to collect your visitor badge.
examples.chinese: 請順道到辦公室領取訪客證。

examples.english: I will stop by the store after work to pick up the order.
examples.chinese: 我下班後會順道到商店取貨。

items.cue: Making use of an offer

examples.english: Take advantage of the early booking discount before Friday.
examples.chinese: 請在星期五以前把握提前預訂的折扣。

items.cue: Handling something for someone

examples.english: Our assistant will take care of the travel arrangements.
examples.chinese: 我們的助理會處理旅行安排。

items.cue: Recording key points

examples.english: Please take notes so we can share the main points later.
examples.chinese: 請做筆記，方便我們之後分享重點。

items.englishDefinition: to leave the ground and begin flying
items.cue: 旅遊與生活情境：take off on time
items.notes: 本詞義不接受直接受詞：the plane takes off。與脫下衣物、事業快速成功等其他詞義分開。

examples.english: Our flight is expected to take off at eight thirty.
examples.chinese: 我們的班機預計八點半起飛。

examples.english: The plane took off late because of strong winds.
examples.chinese: 飛機因強風而延後起飛。

items.englishDefinition: to agree to handle a task or responsibility
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：take on a project
items.notes: 可分：take the project on；代名詞用 take it on。此處學承擔工作，另有雇用的詞義。

examples.english: Our team cannot take on another project this month.
examples.chinese: 我們團隊本月無法再承接另一個專案。

examples.english: Before you take it on, make sure you have enough time to finish.
examples.chinese: 承接這項工作前，請確認有足夠時間完成。

items.englishDefinition: to become responsible for work previously handled by someone else
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：take over a project
items.notes: 可分：take the project over；也可接 from 表示從誰手中接手。take over as 後接職位。

examples.english: Leo will take over the project when the current manager retires.
examples.chinese: 現任經理退休後，Leo 將接手這個專案。

examples.english: The new team is ready to take it over from the contractors.
examples.chinese: 新團隊已準備好從承包商手中接手這項工作。

items.englishDefinition: to go to live somewhere:

examples.english: She took up residence in Canada.
examples.chinese: 她在加拿大定居。

items.englishDefinition: to decide not to accept an offer or request
items.cue: 商務與法規情境：turn down an offer
items.notes: 可分；代名詞用 turn it down。此詞義是拒絕，與調低音量的詞義分開學習。

examples.english: The supplier turned down our request for a longer payment period.
examples.chinese: 供應商拒絕了我們延長付款期限的要求。

examples.english: The position requires weekend work, so Mina decided to turn it down.
examples.chinese: 這個職位需要週末上班，所以 Mina 決定婉拒。

items.englishDefinition: to submit a document or return an item to the appropriate person
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：turn in a report
items.notes: 可分：turn it in。此處學繳交或交還，不是 turn in 的就寢詞義。

examples.english: Employees must turn in their access cards before leaving the company.
examples.chinese: 員工離職前必須交還門禁卡。

examples.english: Once you finish the questionnaire, turn it in at the reception desk.
examples.chinese: 填完問卷後，請交到接待櫃檯。

items.cue: Stopping power to a device

examples.english: Please turn off the lights before leaving the room.
examples.chinese: 離開房間前，請關燈。

items.englishDefinition: to make equipment start working by using a switch
items.cue: 設施與環境情境：turn on the lights
items.notes: 可分：turn the projector on；代名詞用 turn it on。與 turn off 相反。

examples.english: Please turn on the projector before the guests arrive.
examples.chinese: 請在來賓抵達前開啟投影機。

examples.english: The desk lamp is off; could you turn it on for me?
examples.chinese: 桌燈關著，你能幫我打開嗎？

items.cue: A task in progress

examples.english: I am working on the sales report this afternoon.
examples.chinese: 今天下午我正在處理銷售報告。

items.englishDefinition: to develop a practical solution or workable arrangement
items.cue: 職場與人事情境：work out a solution
items.notes: 可分：work it out。此處學想出辦法，不是運動或計算的詞義。

examples.english: The logistics team will work out a cheaper delivery plan.
examples.chinese: 物流團隊將想出較便宜的配送方案。

examples.english: The two departments have a scheduling problem, but they can work it out together.
examples.chinese: 兩個部門的排程有問題，但可以共同解決。

items.englishDefinition: to record information in writing
items.cue: 會議與溝通情境：write down a number
items.notes: 可分：write the number down；代名詞用 write it down。過去式 wrote down。

examples.english: Please write down the reference number before closing the page.
examples.chinese: 關閉頁面前，請寫下查詢編號。

examples.english: The speaker gave us several tips, and I wrote them down.
examples.chinese: 講者提供了幾項建議，我把它們記了下來。
